$comment: Leagues (docs/leagues.md), used by plugins/modes/LeagueMode.plugin.js and LeaguePoints.plugin.js. A league character is the account's separate save a league world logs it into (persistence/PlayerProfile); world.json pluginConfig `league:type` names the league, and `default` only stands in for a type this data does not know. Varbits, varps, scripts and texts are from rsprox Leagues V recordings (osrs-captures 227/00070, 227/00075); the leagues' own numbers (XP rates, starting levels; the relic tiers are league-relics.json) are the Wiki's (Trailblazer_Reloaded_League, Raging_Echoes_League and their /Relics pages). `struct` is the cache's league struct (enum 2670 by league type) whose params the client reads; `colour` is its param 2050 as an RGB int. `passives` are the relic tiers' passive effects (the Relics pages' Tier N bullets), each from the 1-based tier named by `fromTier` (a map picks the highest tier reached): `dropRate` multiplies the boosted drops (league-boosted-drops.json), `runEnergy` stops running from draining energy, `scrollBoxes` drops clue scrolls as scroll boxes without a limit, `minigamePoints` multiplies points asked over `minigame:points`, `slayer` gives Bigger and Badder, superiors 1 in `superiorChance`, task points x `pointsMultiplier` after `freeTasks` tasks, and `combatXp` multiplies the listed skills' XP (Raging Echoes only). Applied by league/Passives.LeagueMode.js and league/BoostedDrops.LeagueMode.js.

journal._comment: The side journal's Leagues tab (side_journal 629:34) mounts the league side panel (656) in the journal's content container (629:43), as the other tabs do on this client; live mounted it in its own tab slot.
